goal: Get visible anime-style cel shading (hard-edged shadow shapes, one shadow tone per colour) on the locked less-human 246 sheet by removing flat-colour wording and the flat v14 reference, adding shading words, and raising denoise to 0.7, while keeping its paws, heads, symmetry, four views, palette and plain white background.
why: Josh asked for shading ("Lets add shading.", "I would like you to apply anime style cell shading") and locked less-human 246 as the parent. He then said: "It sounds like flat colors is getting in way", "I think you should use img2img", "Use the new locked image as the reference". Shading overrides the style guide's flat-colour rule; the rule and palette get updated with shadow tones if he calls this job on-track. Jobs 006 (denoise 0.45) and 007 (0.55, plus anime coloring) both gave no visible shading: all eight images stayed flat, with only paw pads drifting browner. Likely causes: (a) flat-colour wording in the prompt and negative, and a flat v14 reference at IP-Adapter 0.2, held every fill flat; (b) denoise too low to repaint fills. Job 005 at denoise 0.7 showed that 0.7 kept the four-view layout and heads but 2 of 4 images had stray marks, so 0.7 carries that risk and the marks must be checked. Changes against job 007: (1) Parent is the locked copy art/locked/enoch-sheet/enoch-sheet-005-less-human_enoch-sheet_231506246.png, img2img, no canny or edge map. (2) Denoise 0.55 to 0.7, enough to repaint fills with a shadow tone. (3) Prompt: adds 'shaded, shadow, sidelighting' after the shading tags to give the shadows a direction and a reason to exist; removes 'simple shapes, minimal interior lines' (they asked for fewer marks and so work against added shadow shapes); keeps '(cel shading:1.3), (anime coloring:1.1), (simple shading:1.1)'. No flat-colour words are in the prompt. (4) Negative: adds 'flat colors' so the model avoids flat fills; removes '(gradient:1.1)' because it contradicts the shadow wording; keeps '(grey fur:1.3)', 'charcoal grey', '(painterly:1.2)', 'airbrush' and the rest so shadows stay hard-edged and teal does not go grey. (5) IP-Adapter ip-adapter-plus_sdxl_vit-h now uses the locked image as reference in place of v14, at weight 0.25, end 0.5. The reference carries the colours, paws and head so they don't drift at 0.7, but the locked image is flat too, so a low weight and early end (guidance stops at half the steps) leave the later steps free to add shadow tones. This is my choice of weight; it is lower than the 0.4 used before, and higher than 007's 0.2 since the reference is now the exact character rather than the old v14 sheet. Same as 007: seeds 231506246-249 (4 images), Euler a, 30 steps, CFG 6, charsheet_lora_v1 at 0.6, no hires. Check: shading, paws and heads, symmetry, four views, pupils and mask, grey teal, paw-pad drift and stray marks. No masks, guides or pixel edits.
